lines.text: This is Dr. Okafor, medical. If you're hearing this, you restarted the tram. I'm alive. I'm sealed in my lab, and I am staying sealed. Listen. In the farms the infection is doing something it shouldn't. It grows back what you cut off. I need living tissue to understand how.
